description.narrative: The UN Action Against Sexual Violence in Conflict unites the work of the UN system with the goal of ending sexual violence during and after armed conflict. In 2009 UN Action established a Multi-Partner Trust Fund to mobilize funds to support the UN Action Secretariat and programmatic activities.
